Class BarStackBE

java.lang.Object
net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.block.StackBlockEntity
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.block.BarStackBE
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.minecraft.core.TypedInstance<net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntityType<?>>, net.minecraft.util.debug.DebugValueSource
public class BarStackBE extends StackBlockEntity
One Bar Stack: 64 bars laid in eight alternating layers of eight.

A slot index is a position, not a place in a bag, and every bar must rest on the layer beneath it or on the seam with the Bar Stack below. A vertical run of these is a BarColumn, which is what automation addresses; this class owns one block's slots, its shape, and the player-facing cascade that drops whatever an extracted bar was holding up.

Automation exposure is loader-specific and lives outside this class; StackBlockEntity.getItems() is what a loader-specific automation view adapts.

    • onLocalContentsChanged

      protected void onLocalContentsChanged(int slot)
      Description copied from class: StackBlockEntity
      Invalidates subtype-derived local state after a mutation to 0 <= slot < getItems().getSlots(). Runs on either side after dirty/fill updates, even inside a batch, before deferred publication. Disk and client snapshot loads bypass this hook and must refresh subtype state in loadStackData.

    • column

      @Nullable public BarColumn column()
      The column this block belongs to, or null on the client and for a block being removed.

      Resolved once a tick and held, because a machine reading this block's automation view resolves the column once per slot it walks. See StorageStackBE.pile() for the full reasoning.

    • depositAt

      public boolean depositAt(int index, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack fromHand)
      Puts one bar from the given stack into the named position, if that position is empty, valid, and overlapping a bar below. Refuses rather than redirecting the item elsewhere, so a caller walking positions from the bottom fills the supported ones in order.
      Parameters:
      index - the position to fill, in [0, SLOTS)
      Returns:
      whether the bar moved; the hand shrinks by one only then

    • supportSeamBeneath

      @Nullable public static boolean[] supportSeamBeneath(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos pos)
      The seam supporting the bottom layer of a Bar Stack at pos: the top-layer occupancy of the Bar Stack directly below, one entry per position in that top layer, reporting whether a bar is there; BarCubeIdx.seamSupports(int, boolean[]) matches footprints across it. Null means no Bar Stack is below, so the bottom layer rests on the world and is always grounded.
